Not saying there isn't a bit of truth to it, but there are still many companies who have a critical and more healthy approach to AI. reply indiehackers1 1 hour ago | prev [–] Get a 7B model running locally before you touch any API. A quantized 7B is around 4.7GB and runs on a 16GB laptop with no GPU, via llama.cpp. The cost saving is not the point. The point is that you can run the same input seven times in an hour and watch what actually changes. Once you have seen your own quantization and sampling settings move the output, API models stop being magic and become a config you can reason about. Second skill nobody lists: writing loops that fail loudly. Long generations die silently - the stream just stops and your code sits there waiting. I spent days convinced my model was bad before I added a watchdog and per-run logs. The model was fine. My plumbing was not. Both are weekend-sized, no degree needed. And the people making money off this right now are not the ones with the cleverest prompts, they are the ones who can tell a model failure from a pipeline failure. reply uaas 1 hour ago | parent [–] AI reply. reply bittu_much 31 minutes ago | root | parent [–] https://www.slopmanifesto.com reply Guidelines | FAQ | Lists | API | Security | Legal | Apply to YC | Contact
